original_question: Dave ya siyo katon soyayen french fries, ya ci goma sha hudu kafin wani mayunwacin tsuntsun seagull ya sace kayan daga hannunsa. Lokacin da tsuntsun seagull din ya sauka, sai ya zubar da rabin adadin soyayyen da Dave ya ci. Sai tattabarai uku suka koreshi shi daga abincin, kowace tattabara ta ci guda uku. Daga baya, wani raccoon ya sace kashi biyu bisa uku na sauran soyan. Tururuwai kuma sun ɗauki ragowar french fries din, suka bar biyar a baya. French fries nawa ne a cikin fakitin lokacin da Dave ya saya?
